content.body:
The M3A1 Grease Gun is an iconic submachine gun used by the Allied forces. It was cheap to make and effective. Though it had a slower rate of fire than most smg's it was very reliable and the barrel could be changed out to use 9mm rounds.
This limited smg is available for free players as an introductory weapon. By upgrading to a starter or premium account you will receive access to more weapons and vehicles the game has to offer.
content.brief: WEAPON: M3A1 Grease Gun SMG AMMO: .45 cal Auto Colt Pistol (ACP) MAGAZINE: 30 round MUZZLE VELOCITY: 280 m/s RATE OF FIRE: 450 rpm OTHER EQUIPMENT: Mk II HE Grenades (1) Combat Knife
content.title: Limited Submachine Gunner
